changelog.title: OpenMemo 1.8.0
changelog.description:
## [1.8.0] - 2026-05-18

### Added
- Design system rebuild: token-driven CSS, new fonts, full icon set, rebuilt all screens
- Collections page with stacked cards, memo counts, recent titles, edit + drag-to-reorder
- New-memo glass panel with animated tabs (Link/Note/Media/Voice)
- Live Appearance panel: theme, accents, card style, layout, background with fade slider
- Sort dropdown (Recent/Oldest/Title/Custom); command search overlay (⌘K)
- Fullscreen distraction-free writer; storage stats with disk usage breakdown
- Maintenance endpoints (Clear cache, Reset workspace); browser extension card
- First-run onboarding tour; Ask memo chat history with session list
- Local thumbnail cache; dominant-color card backdrops; changelog modal with version check

### Changed
- Memo detail stays routed; new Boxed/Full layout toggle
- Settings redesigned with bento grid masonry; Creator card replaces Identity
- Density locked to roomy; text color reserved for content

### Fixed
- Background image capped 5MB, canvas downscaled before storage
- Collection picker now flyout instead of cropped dropdown
- Masonry columns tightened for better memo card sizing

changelog.title: Live drag-to-reorder
changelog.description:
## Added

  â€¢ `Live drag-to-reorder` â€” cards visually swap in real time while holding and dragging, powered by onDragOver + synchronous dragOrderRef to avoid stale state.
  â€¢ `FLIP settle animation` â€” on drop, framer-motion layout animates each card to its final position with a 250ms ease-out spring.
  â€¢ `Drag lift effect` â€” the held card springs into a slightly scaled, rotated state using framer-motion, matching the motion.dev drag feel.
  â€¢ `README overhaul` â€” updated copy, fixed docs/MEMORY.md and docs/DESIGN.md paths, corrected roadmap link to Specs/ROADMAP.md.

## Changed

  â€¢ `Collision detection â†’ pointerWithin` â€” swap only triggers when the pointer is physically inside another card's bounds; fixes diagonal move mis-fires and cross-column jumps.
  â€¢ `Drag architecture` â€” removed dnd-kit CSS transforms entirely; array order controls card positions, DragOverlay shows the floating ghost.

## Fixed

  â€¢ `Maximum update depth exceeded` â€” caused by rectSortingStrategy measuring DOM rects in a layout effect loop during rapid swaps. Reverted to verticalListSortingStrategy.
  â€¢ `Snap-back on drop` â€” handleDragEnd was reading stale localMemos closure; replaced with synchronous dragOrderRef that updates in the same tick as each swap.
  â€¢ `Up/down drag broken` â€” closestCenter was finding horizontally adjacent cards when dragging vertically; fixed by switching to pointerWithin.

changelog.title: panel fixes â€” search perf & docs
changelog.description:
## Bug fixes

  â€¢ `event.search` â€” refactored from O(n) per-event queries to a single LEFT JOIN; actors grouped in JS after one round-trip.
  â€¢ `Subject detail panel` â€” no longer blocked by loading state; opens immediately on pill click with loading indicator while data fetches.
  â€¢ `Subject detail panel (demo)` â€” builds subject + events from local data when no DB is connected.
  â€¢ `Subject detail panel (spine)` â€” timeline spine repositioned from mid-dates to right of dates, matching main timeline layout.
  â€¢ `Subject detail panel (sort)` â€” years now sorted newest-first, matching main timeline order.
  â€¢ `Subject detail panel (scroll)` â€” mouse wheel scroll now works; Lenis no longer intercepts events inside the panel.
  â€¢ `Settings page` â€” Export and About cards now side by side in the bento grid instead of stacked in one column.

## Documentation

  â€¢ `CONTRIBUTING.md` â€” added setup, workflow, code conventions, domain constants, known gaps.
  â€¢ `ROADMAP.md` â€” restructured with status key, versioned horizons, and all Settings page placeholders documented.
  â€¢ `.env.example` â€” corrected misleading comment on APP_SECRET.

changelog.title: alpha â€” static SVG, 3 insert modes, settings
changelog.description:
## Added

  â€¢ `Icon grid` â€” 263 icons fetched from GitHub Raw registry; 24h localStorage cache with offline fallback.
  â€¢ `Three insert modes` â€” Motion (ItsHover animated, static SVG extraction in this release), SvgIcon (static), CSS Stroke (basic stroke-draw).
  â€¢ `Hover-to-prefetch` â€” 200ms delay prefetch; drag-and-drop + click-to-insert via framer.addSVGNode(); clipboard fallback.
  â€¢ `Settings page` â€” theme toggle, default size slider (16â€“64px), default color picker + presets, cache clear.
  â€¢ `Category filters` â€” All, Arrows, Brand, Social, Letters, Tech filter chips.
  â€¢ `MotionGuide overlay` â€” shown for Motion insert mode.
  â€¢ `Toast notifications` â€” insert feedback toasts.
  â€¢ `Info page` â€” plugin and icon library attribution.

## Changed

  â€¢ `Plugin name` â€” renamed from "ItsHover Icons" to AnimIconSVG in framer.json.
  â€¢ `Design system` â€” Settings and Info pages aligned: same padding (12px), typography scale, section spacing, shared footer.

## Fixed

  â€¢ `Settings viewport` â€” condensed to fit 600px plugin height without scrollbar.
  â€¢ `Info page footer` â€” now pins to bottom of viewport.
  â€¢ `Missing dependency` â€” installed vite-plugin-framer dev dependency.

changelog.title: dashboard settings â€” layout cleanup & editor fixes
changelog.description:
## Added

  â€¢ `Dashboard grid density control` â€” 4/5 memo-card layout setting in SettingsPage so dashboard density can be changed from Settings.
  â€¢ `Grid preference persistence` â€” dashboardGridColumns state and setter to the app store so the chosen layout survives refreshes.
  â€¢ `Masonry dashboard` â€” masonry-style layout for the main dashboard to better accommodate variable memo card heights.
  â€¢ `Inline BAF action` â€” moved the BAF/Add New action beside the search bar for faster dashboard access.
  â€¢ `Full note-detail editing` â€” note detail editor, rendered markdown view, and toolbar improvements.
  â€¢ `Settings redesign foundation` â€” bento-style Settings redesign, creator/info cards, and supporting stats improvements.

## Changed

  â€¢ `Appearance settings flow` â€” dashboard grid control inside Appearance section with refined segmented control styling.
  â€¢ `Dashboard layout wiring` â€” MemoGrid now reads the saved dashboard grid preference instead of a hardcoded 5-column layout.
  â€¢ `Header and navigation polish` â€” dashboard top bar, inline controls, hamburger/header work, and homepage CSS refinements aligned.
  â€¢ `Memo card readability` â€” cleaned up memo card text hierarchy for clearer scanning.
  â€¢ `FAB behavior` â€” Speed Dial flow now aligns better with direct note creation and inline dashboard actions.

## Removed

  â€¢ `Floating FAB wiring` â€” removed from Layout.tsx along with stale related imports and unused state.
  â€¢ `MemoCast surface` â€” continued cleanup of MemoCast-facing navigation and routing in the active UI flow.
  â€¢ `Broken settings collapse` â€” removed inconsistent keyboard-shortcuts collapse behavior from Settings.

## Fixed

  â€¢ `Speed dial JSX` â€” fixed the broken JSX block in SpeedDialFAB.tsx.
  â€¢ `Hover animation jitter` â€” separated parent positioning transforms from child hover scale transforms in SpeedDialFAB.tsx.
  â€¢ `Duplicate store destructure` â€” removed the repeated useAppStore() destructure that caused redeclare issues.
  â€¢ `Store wiring for grid controls` â€” fixed missing app store state/setter pair so 4/5 dashboard buttons work correctly.
  â€¢ `Markdown paste and render` â€” preserved markdown syntax on paste, improved code block handling, tightened typography.
  â€¢ `Markdown editor view-first` â€” fixed read/view mode initialization and blur-save handling.
